mapper.sql: SELECT o.*, s.student_no, s.name AS student_name, s.major, s.class_name, m.name AS mentor_name, l.name AS lab_name FROM offer o JOIN student s ON s.id = o.student_id JOIN mentor m ON m.id = o.mentor_id JOIN lab l ON l.id = o.lab_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO offer (batch_id, student_id, mentor_id, lab_id, application_id, intent_id, supplement_intent_id, source, status, round_no, created_by) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{studentId}, #{mentorId}, #{labId}, #{applicationId}, #{intentId}, #{supplementIntentId}, #{source}, #{status}, #{roundNo}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: WHERE o.batch_id = #{batchId} AND o.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC
WHERE o.batch_id = #{batchId} AND o.mentor_id = #{mentorId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE offer SET status = #{status}, confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE offer SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND batch_id = #{batchId} AND status = 'OFFERED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM offer WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
